name: Northharbor
description: This bustling port city thrives on trade with the Freelands and Kepesh Theocracy. Ruled by a savvy Jarl from the Walrus Clan, known as a tough seafarer, the city’s harbors are its soul, full of colorful masts of Drakkars and the resonant noise of commerce. The people of Northarbor, hardened by the freezing waters in which they swim from youth, are renowned as the most enduring warriors. Though they are the most pacifist and diplomatic clans, they possess great tenacity and can become terrifyingly violent when provoked, traits they believe mirror the walrus displayed on their flags. Yet beneath the surface of this vibrant trade center, tensions arise between the revolutionaries and the imperial loyalists as whispers of treason and dishonor spread. While alliances forged in commerce with the Republic have strengthened some bonds, others believe staying with the Empire is necessary to avoid war. Amidst these internal struggles, they must stand against the sea threat as the Kemets’ fleet has seized significant portions of the Dead Island Archipelago, bringing a creeping mystical winter from their temples of Bás, along with their hordes of undead. The Walrus Clan and the city of Northarbor stand defiant, safeguarding their home and fighting to stop the Kemets from advancing into the continent.
